## Full screen that stays on your desktop (macOS)

### macOS

- **Full screen no longer moves the window to its own Space.** The green button and **Ctrl+Cmd+F** now fill the display the window is on, hide the menu bar and Dock, and leave it on the current desktop. QLab and its video outputs stay where they are, and Cmd-Tab between the two apps works as usual. Press the shortcut again to go back to the window you had. If you move the window to another display, unplug a display or change resolution while in full screen, the window fits itself to the new layout.
- The app doesn't save the full-screen size as your window size: the next launch opens at the size you had before going full screen.

### Good to know

- Windows and Linux are unchanged.
- Android monitor: built with Android Gradle Plugin 9.5.2.
